pupilCopy.importance: The system should treat the cooking area, rather than fill the whole room.
pupilCopy.solution: Smoke and heat sensors linked to an aimed stove nozzle using cooking-oil-rated wet chemical.
pupilCopy.how_it_works:
1. Smoke and heat sensors alert the controller.
2. The nozzle aims at the stove zone.
3. Wet chemical is applied to that cooking area.
pupilCopy.source_caveat: A real kitchen needs a suitable system fitted by qualified fire-safety specialists.
pupilCopy.next_test: Use a dry model. Ask a qualified fire-system specialist.
how_it_works_steps: Smoke and heat sensors alert the controller.
The nozzle aims at the stove zone.
Wet chemical is applied to that cooking area.
